title: Hellfire
description: A Modpack designed to make Minecraft just a tad harder, with Natural Health Regeneration removed.
body:
# Hellfire
**_Hellfire is currently a work in progress!_**

Welcome to Hellfire! A heavily crafted modpack designed to make Minecraft just a slighly bit harder. This modpack introduces a tweaked progression system, as well as new advancements, buffed mobs, and more!

Keep in mind, the modpack is not currently finished. This means a lot of things may be unbalanced, too unfair, or too unforgiving. While I have playtested it myself, and deemed it to be currently playable, I have not tested everything.

## Q&A
### What Features are in the Modpack?
I have coded my own Datapack to tweak everything even further. This introduces things like Acid Rain, Achievements, tweaked progression in your world, removal of items and mobs, as well as buffed mobs and bosses.

There is also no **Natural Health Regeneration**, and crop growth has been slowed heavily.

I would not say everything is finished at the moment, and some of my buffs may be a little too unforgiving.

### What Mods are in the Modpack?
I'll list a few. I don't want to ruin the surprise, after all.

- No Tree Punching
- Tough As Nails
- Body Health System
- Limited Lives
- Improved Mobs
- Enhanced Celestials

### What have you not tested yet?
I have not currently tested Enchaned Celestials fully. I only added it because I believe it adds Blood Moons, but I have yet to see it occur in my playtesting. I do not know if it is balanced or fair enough for the changes I already made using my datapack.

### Why is it called Hellfire?
I just thought it sounded cool, no real reason. It was meant to be temporary, but I really don't want to go back in to my Datapack and change the name for everything.

### Do you have any future plans?
Yes! If the modpack gets decently popular (messured by how many people are in our Discord), and if I can collect enough Donations (if I even set those up, I may just end up doing this for free), I will host a Anarchy Hellfire Minecraft Server!

### Can I give suggestions?
Yes! You can join the Discord Server [here](https://discord.gg/jb6gNntBqP).
